theorem sub3 {pp : P} (hF : 2768 + 8 * (pp.a.used + pp.b.used) ≤ pp.sp) (y : Y) : (ρ3 pp y).Sub (MpMul.lay pp (proj y)) := by
  rcases y with _ | r
  · simp [ρ3, Split.lay, MpMul.lay, proj, Iv.Sub]; omega
  · cases r <;> simp [ρ3, Split.lay, MpMul.lay, proj, Iv.Sub] <;> omega

theorem posG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : MPre pp mm rr) (y : Y) :
    0 < (ρ3 pp y).len ∨ (ρ3 pp y).base < heapStart ∨ heapEnd ≤ (ρ3 pp y).base := by
  have := hP.res.apos; have := hP.res.bpos; have := hP.res.cpos
  rcases y with _ | r
  · left; simp [ρ3, Split.lay, MpMul.lay]
  · cases r <;> (left; simp [ρ3, Split.lay, MpMul.lay, textIv, textLen]; try omega)

/-- The heap checkpoint at the entry. -/
theorem entry_hp {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : MPre pp mm rr) :
    HP (ρX pp) wX (MpMul.hin pp) (MpMul.hin pp) (InAny (MpMul.lay pp) MpMul.ws) mm mm := by
  have hF : 2768 + 8 * (pp.a.used + pp.b.used) ≤ pp.sp := by have := hP.res.stk.lo; have e : heapEnd = 0x87800000 := rfl; simp only [MpMul.F, MpMul.Fm, MpMul.μ] at this; omega
  have hstk : Ram (MpMul.lay pp .stk).base (MpMul.lay pp .stk).len := (hP.bund .stk).2
  refine HP.entry hP.heap (fun y => (hP.off (proj y)).sub (sub3 hF y) (posG hP y)) ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy q hq
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    have hq2 : (ρ3 pp y).In q := hq
    have hq' : (MpMul.lay pp (proj y)).In q := by unfold Iv.Sub Iv.In at *; omega
    rcases y with _ | r
    · exact InAny.of_mem (w := MpMul.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
    · cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, MpMul.isW] at hy
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := MpMul.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := MpMul.R.cS) (by decide) hq'
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := MpMul.R.cD) (by decide) hq'
  · intro y hy
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    rcases y with _ | r
    · exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
    · cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, MpMul.isW] at hy
      · exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
      · simpa [ρ3, Split.lay, MpMul.lay, Layout.sizeofMpInt] using (Hdr.geom (show Hdr mm pp.pc pp.cdp pp.c from (hP.bund .cS).2)).st
      · simpa [ρ3, Split.lay, MpMul.lay] using (show Dig mm pp.cdp pp.c.alloc pp.c.digit from (hP.bund .cD).2).ram
